description: Outcome of every statistics fixture at the ingest of POST /v1/stats/reports when it is posted with a valid signature: the status, the problem code, errors[0].path and errors[0].code (error). layer "schema" fixtures fail (or pass) JSON Schema validation alone; layer "ingest" fixtures need the ingest checks beyond the schema (body size, number syntax, duplicate keys). The platform, the SDK and the product builders all read this file.

valid/gauzy.json.reason: the gauzy golden: every key is allow-listed

valid/teams.json.reason: the teams golden: every key is allow-listed

valid/works.json.reason: the works golden: every key is allow-listed

valid/rec.json.reason: the rec golden: every key is allow-listed

valid/traduora.json.reason: the traduora golden: every key is allow-listed

invalid/01-extra-field.json.reason: unknown key; the top-level object is closed

invalid/03-per-record-array.json.reason: amounts are one integer per currency per period

invalid/04-email-in-country.json.reason: country is two letters or ZZ

invalid/07-oversize.json.reason: the body is larger than 16 KiB

invalid/08-foreign-product-key.json.reason: a Works key inside a Gauzy report

invalid/09-version-suffix.json.reason: a build suffix could name a company

invalid/10-open-map-key.json.reason: nested map keys come from a closed list

invalid/11-integral-float.json.reason: a number written with a fraction is not an integer on the wire

invalid/13-sent-at-with-time.json.reason: sent_at is a UTC date: a time of day could match a request log line
